newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish army officer shot dead, car blown up.
newsitem.headline: Spanish army officer shot dead, car blown up.

text.p: A Spanish army officer was shot dead by a woman in an apparent guerrilla attack in northeast Madrid on Wednesday, officials said.
A car exploded shortly afterwards near a shopping centre in the same neighbourhood and slightly injured a young man.
Police said the car could have been used by the attackers responsible for the shooting.

An Interior Ministry spokeswoman told Reuters the shooting happened at 3.15 p.m. (1415 GMT) when a young woman and a man approached Lieutenant-Colonel Jesus Cuesta, 60, as he got out of his car to enter his house.
The woman fired twice, hitting Cuesta in the head and jaw, while the man fired at the officer's driver without wounding him. Cuesta died shortly after arriving at hospital.

The officials did not say whether it was thought the attack had been carried out by Basque separatist guerrillas of ETA, but the group has often targeted members of security forces in its 28-year drive for Basque independence.
Interior Minister Jaime Mayor Oreja warned on Tuesday that ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) would launch attacks in retaliation for recent police arrests of youths linked to the separatist group.
